integrity: Mathematical argument is a finite-padding identity and two-way progression transport; independent audit has not been performed. Finite code checks are diagnostics rather than a proof of all quantified cases.
limitations: No result is claimed for the two excluded extreme patterns, origin-constrained progressions, exact common numerical progression maxima, or complete trace languages without reversal and residue translation. Prior-art identification is not a proof of global uniqueness.
scientific_scope: Every integer base b>=2, modulus m>=2, difference d>=1, and any nonempty digit pattern v other than the all-zero and all-(b-1) patterns; overlapping contiguous counts use leading-zero convention.
title: Digit-complement reflection preserves monochromatic progression maxima in every base and modulus
